8 Oktoberfest 2026 Events In Singapore With Authentic Bavarian Cuisine, Music & More

Posted on 09 September, 2026 | By Sassy Mama
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:01
Instaread
Post Category - EatEat - Post Category - Eating OutEating Out - Post Category - Date Night / Sans KidsDate Night / Sans Kids
Post Category - EatEat - Post Category - Eating OutEating Out - Post Category - Date Night / Sans KidsDate Night / Sans Kids

Eins, Zwei, Drei, G’suffa! Get ready for Oktoberfest 2026! Put on your dancing shoes, Dirndl or Lederhosen, grab a beer and get ready to party as you celebrate this German tradition right here in Singapore.

Oktoberfest is back! Oktoberfest is an annual festival that originated in Munich, Germany, and is usually held over a two-week period from September to the first Sunday in October. Lots of countries, Singapore included, hold these Munich-style Oktoberfests featuring plenty of German beer, Bavarian food and a party-like vibe in an attempt to reproduce the Bavarian sense of gemütlichkeit – cordiality.

Sound like lots of fun, just like the festival’s Irish counterpart, St Patrick’s Day? Grab a beer and your friends (Bavarian costumes of Dirndl or Lederhosen optional) and party the night away at all these places holding Oktoberfest 2026 events this year–and yes, there will be a lot of beer, delicious German food, and music!

        Read more: Steak Lovers’ Guide: Best Steakhouses in Singapore

1. Swiss Club Singapore: Oktoberfest 2026 with live music, food and games

Oktoberfest at Swiss Club Singapore is one of the most popular Oktoberfest events in Singapore, and tickets sell out fast! Sit back and enjoy live music from their award-winning 10-piece Bavarian brass band, Musikkapelle Partenkirchen, and get ready for a full night of dancing, singing, drinking and eating as you celebrate Oktoberfest 2026. This Oktoberfest event culminates on Früschoppen Sunday, where there’s a huge traditional German and Swiss buffet, goodies such as popcorn, cotton candy and ice cream, a bouncy castle and event a magic show!

When: 16 – 19 September 2026, 6.30pm till late; Früschoppen Sunday on 20 September 2026, 11am – 3pm
Where: Swiss Club Singapore
How much: $75 – $150 per adult ($60 for beverage coupons);  Früschoppen Sunday: $50/adult & $30 kids aged 6 to 12 – Get tickets here.

2. Paulaner Bräuhaus Singapore: Oktoberfest 2026 with live music

One of the largest Oktoberfest events in Singapore is coming back this year! Save the date for an epic Oktoberfest celebration at Paulaner Bräuhaus Singapore. From beer shots to authentic German food, you’re sure to get a night to remember when you join in the festive fun. Plus, enjoy live music by Joe & Seine Schürzenjäger and Dirndlpower from Germany, as well as DJ Fabeat and DJ Knightndae!

When: 3 September – 31 October 2026
Where: Paulaner Bräuhaus Singapore
How much: Ticket prices range from $79++ to $150++ and serves as F&B credit. More info here.

3. Lau Pa Sat Erdinger Oktoberfest Street Festival

Oktoberfest at one of Singapore’s most iconic hawker centres? Count us in. Lau Pa Sat transforms into an “Oktoberfest wonderland” dubbed the Erdinger Oktoberfest Street Festival. Head over for an array of traditional Bavarian games and live music. Last year’s fun included a Stein Holding Competition (hold a traditional beer mug for as long as you can!), a beer photo op and merch giveaways.

When: 18, 19, 25 & 26 September 2026
Where: Lau Pa Sat
How much: Free entry – Stay tuned here.

4. Tanah Merah Country Club: Oktoberfest golf & poolside dining

The Tanah Merah Country Club is celebrating Oktoberfest 2026 in Singapore with a spin. Save the date for a day of golf on the Garden Course, followed by dinner at the Garden Banquet Room. There’ll be German-inspired dishes, free-flow beer, live music and lucky draws.

When: 26 September 2026, Golf at 1.15pm, Dinner at 6pm
Where: Tanah Merah Country Club
How much: From $88 – More info here.

5. Seletar Country Club: Oktoberfest 2026 buffet dinner & live performance

Feast to your heart’s content at Seletar Country Club’s Oktoberfest 2026 featuring  day of golf and a buffet dinner at Seletar Tavern. Indulge in Crispy German Roasted Pork Knuckle, and pair it with all-you-can-drink beer. Look forward to a live performance of traditional German folk music, drinking tunes, polkas, waltzes and all your favourite rock and pop songs by Tropic Oompah.

When: 2 October 2026, 6pm – 11pm
Where: Seletar Country Club
How much: From $100 – More info here.

6. The Chevrons: Oktoberfest buffet, photobooth & more

Recreational club, The Chevrons has plenty of fun for the family this Oktoberfest. Prepare yourself for a feast as there’ll be a German buffet with live cooking stations. Setting the festive mood are DJs and a live band. Come dressy to take advantage of the photobooth, and put on your competitive hat to take on some games, a rodeo bull challenge and lucky draw.

When: 2 October 2026, 7pm – 11pm
Where: Aviary KTV, The Chevrons
How much: Early bird $60 for members, $80 for guests;  Standard $70 for members, $90 for guests – register here.

7. Serangoon Gardens Country Club Oktoberfest 2026

The annual Oktoberfest celebration is back at Serangoon Gardens Country Club. Look forward to a hearty buffet of bratwurst, Bavarian beef stew, roasted pork knuckle, apple strudel and more. Join in the festivities with live entertainment. A glass of Paulaner beer is also included!

When: 9 October 2026, 7pm – 11pm
Where: Serangoon Gardens Country Club
How much: From $60 – stay updated here.

8. Tanglin CC Oktoberfest: Affordable Oktoberfest dinner

Tanglin folks, there’s an Oktoberfest event near you and it’s gentle on the wallet! The Tanglin Community Club has a one-day-only Oktoberfest event, and you can expect a lively celebration of German culture. Each ticket entitles you to the buffet dinner filled with German specialities with a live station and one beer while you enjoy tunes performed by the Tanglin CC Music Club Band.

When: 3 October 2026, 5.30pm – 9pm
Where: Tanglin CC
How much: $28 – get tickets here

Past & Upcoming Oktoberfest 2026 events in Singapore

Clarke Quay Oktoberfest 2026 celebrations

There’s a weekend of Oktoberfest celebrations taking place at Clarke Quay’s Fountain Square. Look forward to live performances and DJs, plus Oktoberfest games such as a Pretzel Toss and Hammer & Wood Chopping Machine! There are some sweet Erdinger beer promos to take advantage of and pint bundles are available, too!

When: TBA
Where: TBA – Clarke Quay
How much: TBA

Haji Lane Erdinger Oktoberfest Street Festival

The Erdinger Oktoberfest Street Festival extends over to Haji Lane, also with an array of fun traditional Bavarian games. Try your hand at the Stein Holding Competition that’ll put you through three challenging rounds. There’s also the Oktoberquest Adventure where you can complete challenges to fill up a stamp card to win some fun merch. You can even get a free Erdinger pint when you sign up for a Drinkies account.

When: TBA
Where: Haji Lane
How much: Free entry!

Cosford Container Park: Oktoberfest food & weekend market

Cosford Container Park invites you to get a taste of Bavaria with their Oktobefest weekend. Look forward to a Bavarian fair of handmade crafts, festive decor, gifts and more. More details will be announced closer to the date!

When: TBA
Where: 30 Cosford Road, Singapore 499550
How much: Free entry! Stay tuned here.

Oktoberfest@Padang by the Singapore Recreation Club

There’s a festival of Bavarian food and drinks taking place at Oktoberfest@Padang, organised by the Singapore Recreation Club! There’ll be live entertainment, including authentic Bavarian music and more!

When: TBA
Where: Singapore Recreation Club
How much: TBA – stay tuned here.
